note_for_reviewer: What is whose: shot 1 is the original emblem (emblem/reference/original.png), not funkbox's work, captioned as the original. The redraw with the extra letter and longer Hebrew line was hand-made outside funkbox (emblem/reference/A-faithful.png); the caption says 'redrawn and traced' and claims only the trace for funkbox. The artwork in shots 2-6 is image_trace's vector trace of the redraw (and of the two mashup pictures in refs/hebrew-emblem-v2/) with the lettering lifted out (emblem/trace/). Every word on the emblems is a funkbox text layer from emblem/emblem.copy.json; emblem/renders/*.text_audit.json shows them exact. No scores are claimed on screen (emblem/compare/ has them for the record: 97.6, 97.3, 97.1). The emblem redraws an existing organisation's emblem; the two IDF-insignia mashups (shots mash-b, mash-c) are covered by owner_approval.json, which approves that content only.
